# BB00522: Du'a Hajat {.unnumbered}

O God! Send down upon me Thy mercy, for unto Thee belongeth all mercy.

O God! Bless Muhammad, Thy Beloved, and the Prophets, and fulfill my needs.

O God! Bless the Points of Thy Cause and those whom Thou hast loved among Thy guides, and fulfill my needs.

O God! By Thee and upon Thee and the Manifestations of Thy names, I beseech Thee to suffice me in what concerns me regarding my worldly affairs and the life to come, for Thou art my sufficiency and Thou art powerful over all things.

O God! Forgive me and those who have believed in Thee, whether male or female, and fulfill our needs, for Thou art the Guardian of the believers.

O God! Fulfill our needs through all Thy names and all Thy examples. Leave us not to ourselves nor to any of Thy creation.

O God! Protect us from the evil of those who have disbelieved and make us independent of all things.

O Lord! Unto Thee I repair for refuge and toward all Thy signs I set my heart.

O Lord! Whether traveling or at home, and in my occupation or in my work, I place my whole trust in Thee. Grant me then Thy sufficing help so as to make me independent of all things, O Thou Who art unsurpassed in Thy mercy!

Bestow upon me my portion, O Lord, as Thou pleasest, and cause me to be satisfied with whatsoever Thou hast ordained for me. Thine is the absolute authority to command.

O Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from all that the accursed Satan may bring.

O Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from all Thine enemies.

O God! Protect me from the evil of the oppressors and from the followers of darkness.

Glory be unto Thee! Thou art the Best of protectors.
